title: Uniqueness of tangent plane and multiplicity in Def. 1.1
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N and x ∈ ℝ^N. If HasTangentPlane V x T θ and HasTangentPlane V x T' θ', then T' = T and θ' = θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T T' : Grassmannian N n) (θ θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasTangentPlane V x T' θ' → T' = T ∧ θ' = θ
